owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).

The owner taps worlds, stars, pips, the tilt dial and gauge rows, drags stars, pips, the dial and gauge rows, double-taps empty space and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on a world sends inspectWorld for it, or clears it when it is already inspected; a tap on a star selects it and explains it; a tap on a luminosity pip or the tilt dial while playing sends exactly one star.luminosity or orbit.tilt for the nearest pip when it differs, and a locked brightness or a single level is explained; a tap or drag on a gauge row shows the tick under the finger (clock.show, never an undo step); a star drag (16 points or more) is a phase drag along the orbit tangent or else a ring drag, shows the kernel's own report for the change with the star drawn as a ghost and sends exactly one star.ring or star.phase on release, and nothing when the target is unchanged; a drag on a pip row or the dial previews one step per 32 points and sends exactly one star.luminosity or orbit.tilt on release when it differs; a gesture on a finished play explains why nothing happens; a double tap on empty space (within 0.35 s and 22 points) restores the authored view; two fingers orbit within yaw plus or minus 60 degrees and pitch -20 to +35 degrees.
rows.procedure: Tap a world to inspect it and again to clear it, tap a star to select it, tap a luminosity pip and the tilt dial to set them, tap and drag along a gauge row to show a tick, drag a star across its rings and along its orbit to preview and set the change, drag along a luminosity pip row and the tilt dial to preview and set the value, double-tap empty space to reset the view and orbit the camera with two fingers on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

Level won spending a actions, k of 3 stars.", the failure explanation, and the refusal "That ring, phase, brightness or tilt change cannot be made (locked, unchanged, off the phase grid or too close to the other star), or there is nothing to undo or redo.").
